messages:
Maya: Heads-up — design review at 3pm. Going to propose a small change to playground's tool-calling output: flatten nested results by default.
Sam: Flatten by default sounds risky. We lose schema fidelity for tools that return structured traces.
Maya: Agreed, maybe a 'Compact view' toggle? Default = full structured, but compact is easier to scan in run history.
Jordan: +1 for toggle. Also need copy changes: 'Invoke' -> 'Run with tools' or 'Run with integrations'?
Alex: 'Invoke' confuses PMs. 'Run' is more generic. 'Run with tools' is verbose. Maybe 'Run (tools on)'.
Maya: Agree, prefer 'Run with tools' — explicit for new users.
Sam: Accessibility nit: the toggle must be keyboard-focusable and announce when it switches. Use aria-pressed on the button and live region when content changes.
Jordan: Also need semantic headings in run history cards — 'Output' vs 'Tool output' vs 'Function result'.
Alex: UX concern: When tool result is big, we should show first 3 lines with "Show more" and keep the compact diffable JSON view.
Maya: Also proposal: when tool returns objects, show key-path pillstrip that allows expanding particular keys inline.
Sam: Implementation note: backend currently returns tool outputs as 'tool_result' blob. If we add indexing for paths, might need prefix KV cache changes.
Jordan: For copy: tooltip on schema editor should say 'Define function inputs & outputs to enable structured results and better diffs.'
Maya: Mockups: I'll drop Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx — please comment.
Designbot: New mock uploaded by Maya (3 files).
Alex: Small nit — use sentence-case in labels, not ALL CAPS. Eg 'Show more' not 'SHOW MORE'.
Sam: Edge case: tool-calling + streaming — how do we show partial tool outputs? Maybe stream into the compact view and mark incomplete.
Maya: Good point. Let's add 'in-progress' badge and progressive height expansion.
Jordan: Accessibility: ensure role=button for key-path pills and allow Enter/Space to expand.
Alex: For run-history permalinks, we should include parameter to default to compact view ?compact=1
Maya: TL;DR action items: 1) Maya: update mock for toggle + key-path pills; 2) Sam: add aria props & live region plan; 3) Alex: propose final copy changes; 4) Jordan: spec streaming partials. Back here EOD.
Sam: Looks good. :thumbsup:
Jordan: I'll add a short dev doc for streaming behavior.
Maya: Thanks y'all!
